create_quantized_rnn_cell: create a quantized RNN cell with custom weight quantization parameters and tanh nonlinearity
create_quantized_lstm: create a quantized LSTM module with multiple layers, bidirectional support, and weight quantization params
create_quantized_gru: create a quantized GRU module with configurable layers, dropout, and per-tensor or per-channel quantization
convert_float_rnn_to_quantized: convert a float RNN, LSTM, or GRU module to its quantized reference counterpart using from_float
get_quantized_weights: get quantized weight tensors or quantize-and-dequantized float weights from a quantized RNN module
